title: SimpleWardenDrops
description: This plugin adds a simple setup method to give the Warden more useful drops – either via a GUI, commands, or classically via config.yml.
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e048154d7b504366c83f612564ab3c816099a08.png) 
(Picture by textstudio.com)


With this plugin, you can finally add useful drops to The Warden!

The plugin is easy to use: you can either add drops in config.yml, set them up using commands, or – most conveniently – manage them directly via the clear GUI.

You can also edit or delete existing drops at any time.

Important: After each change, you must execute /wd reload for the new settings to take effect.
